'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a quest item, obtained from a chest in level 5 of the [[Dungeon]] as part of a quest for [[Snake]]. {{PAGENAME}} can also be crafted at the [[Church workbench]].

It can be used to give blood to the [[Master Alaric|Vampire]].

There is no other use for this item other than as a quest item. It cannot be used to collect the contents of the bucket, unlike the other bucket items.
